assets.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: Careers page editorial hero photograph for Veda Group, an international business development consultancy.
Primary request: Four diverse adult colleagues, women and men, collaborating around a walnut table in a contemporary daylight office; an engaged junior colleague shares an idea while a senior colleague listens, communicating career growth, shared ambition and international teamwork.
Style/medium: Premium candid editorial business photography, believable human faces and hands, authentic relaxed professional expressions, no staged handshake or camera-facing poses.
Composition/framing: Landscape 4:3 image, waist-up group framed centrally with ample safe margin on all sides for a 1.3:1 website crop. People are the clear focal point; laptop, notebook and a few papers subtly support the conversation.
Lighting/mood: Soft natural window daylight, calm welcoming atmosphere.
Color palette: Muted navy, warm walnut, pale stone and subtle teal, matching an understated premium business website.
Constraints: No text, logos, watermark, collage, borders or website UI. Avoid excessive luxury, empty rooms, dramatic skyline and stock-photo grins.
